title: Decouple: `issue_invoice`
body: Normalise `issued_at` to UTC using `datetime.timezone.utc` instead of `ZoneInfo('UTC')`. Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.

title: Refactor: `is_overdue`
body: Make the comparison explicit and readable. Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.

title: Feature: `is_overdue`
body: Add `grace_days: int = 0` with the same meaning as in collections tooling. Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.

title: Feature: `due_date`
body: Add `business_days: bool = False`; when True, count only Mon-Fri. Default behaviour unchanged. Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.

title: Feature: `issue_invoice`
body: Our CSV importer passes `issued_at` as an ISO-8601 string (e.g. '2026-03-01T09:30:00+09:00'). Accept strings as well as datetimes. Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.

title: Decouple: `due_date`
body: Compute the due date inline so `due_date` no longer calls `local_issue_date`. Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.

title: Performance: `local_issue_date`
body: Cache ZoneInfo lookups. Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.

title: Refactor: `days_overdue`
body: Simplify the function and give the intermediate values clear names. Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.

title: Refactor: `issue_invoice`
body: Move the input validation to the top in a clear order and simplify the body. Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.

title: Feature: `days_overdue`
body: Add `grace_days: int = 0`; an invoice is only overdue after the grace period. Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.

title: Performance: `compute_totals`
body: Make a single pass over the items instead of three separate sums. Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.

title: Performance: `due_date`
body: Avoid constructing a ZoneInfo object on every call (cache it). Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.

title: Performance: `issue_invoice`
body: Avoid validating the time zone twice. Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.

title: Decouple: `days_overdue`
body: Compute days overdue directly from `issued_at` and `net_days` instead of calling `due_date`. Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.

title: Feature: `local_issue_date`
body: Add an optional `tz: str | None` that overrides the customer's time zone. Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.

title: Refactor: `compute_totals`
body: Extract the free-shipping rule into a small local helper and simplify the function. Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.

title: Feature: `compute_totals`
body: Add an optional `coupon` (absolute amount off the order, default '0') applied after line discounts; it must not make the taxable amount negative. Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.

title: Decouple: `is_overdue`
body: Compare `now` against the due date directly instead of calling `days_overdue`. Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.

title: Feature: `compute_totals`
body: Add `shipping_region_surcharge: dict | None` mapping region -> extra shipping amount, applied before the free-shipping check. Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.

title: Decouple: `compute_totals`
body: Compute subtotal and discount inline from the items instead of calling `line_subtotal`/`line_discount`. Existing behaviour and all current callers must keep working.
